methodology: Per-function approximation: 1 + if/while/for/try + short-circuit boolean operators + max(match arm count - 1, 0). Body token lines include braces and declarations within bodies; they approximate executable source, not machine instructions.
limitations: Physical full-file lines include comments, blanks and tests; a second count excludes exact test-attributed item/attribute rows.
Same exact cfg(test)/test exclusions as source metrics; complex cfg conditions remain. Mutually exclusive branches may both count.
Macros are not expanded. Their invocation count is reported; generated decision paths cannot be inferred from source tokens.
Unconditional loop alone adds no decision. Panic/unwind and implicit library/control-flow behavior are not modeled.
Sum includes one base per function and is not a whole-program path count. Nested function syntax, when present, is charged to its enclosing body.
